privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
This privacy policy aims to inform ORANOS TRANS website users about the collection, use, protection, and processing of their personal data, in accordance with Moroccan Law No. 09-08, promulgated by Dahir No. 1-09-15 of February 18, 2009.

### 1. Data Controller

The person responsible for processing personal data collected on the site is:

**ORANOS TRANS**
**Address:** 4 LOT HOURIA, Boulevard Palestine, Mohammedia – Morocco
**Phone:** +212 6 63 71 40 40
**Email:** contact@oranostrans.com

### 2. Collected Personal Data

ORANOS TRANS may collect the following personal data:

*   Full name
*   Email address
*   Phone number
*   Information related to quote requests or contact
*   Cargo information (nature, weight, dimensions, origin, destination)
*   Attached files voluntarily submitted (packing list, logistics documents, Excel files)

This data is collected only when the user voluntarily provides it through the forms available on the site.

### 3. Purposes of Processing

The personal data collected is used exclusively for the following purposes:

*   Processing transport and logistics quote requests
*   Responding to contact or information requests
*   Commercial follow-up and customer relations
*   Improving the quality of services offered
*   Administrative and operational management of services

The data is under no circumstances used for purposes not intended or incompatible with the purposes mentioned above.

### 4. Legal Basis for Processing

The processing of personal data is based on:

*   The user's explicit consent upon form submission
*   The necessity of processing for the execution of transport services or logistics services
*   Compliance with legal and regulatory obligations applicable to ORANOS TRANS

### 5. Data Retention

Personal data is kept for a period strictly necessary for the fulfillment of the purposes for which it was collected, unless otherwise required by law.

Once the retention periods have expired, the data is securely deleted or anonymized.

### 6. Data Confidentiality and Security

ORANOS TRANS is committed to ensuring the confidentiality and security of the personal data processed. Appropriate technical and organizational measures are implemented to protect the data against loss, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. Access to data is strictly limited to authorized persons within the company.

### 7. Data Sharing

The personal data collected is neither sold, rented, nor transferred to third parties. However, it may be communicated to technical partners or subcontractors only when necessary for the performance of requested services (e.g., IT service providers), in strict compliance with Law 09-08.

### 8. User Rights

In accordance with Moroccan Law No. 09-08, the user has the following rights:

*   Right of access to their personal data
*   Right to rectify inaccurate or incomplete data
*   Right to object to processing for legitimate reasons
*   Right to delete data, within the limits provided by law

Any request relating to the exercise of these rights should be addressed in writing to: contact@oranostrans.com

### 9. Cookies

The ORANOS TRANS site may use cookies or similar technologies for operational, analytical, and user experience improvement purposes. The user can configure their browser to refuse or limit the use of cookies.

### 10. Modification of the Privacy Policy

ORANOS TRANS reserves the right to modify this privacy policy at any time to adapt it to legal, regulatory, or technical developments. The updated version will be published on the site and will take effect as soon as it is online.

### 11. Applicable Law

This privacy policy is governed by Moroccan law. Any dispute relating to the interpretation or execution of this policy falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of Moroccan courts.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.content:
These General Terms and Conditions define the rules for using the ORANOS TRANS website and the conditions applicable to the transport and logistics services offered by the company.

Any use of the site implies full and complete acceptance of these General Terms and Conditions.

### 1. Company Presentation

ORANOS TRANS is a company specializing in road transport and logistics services.

**Headquarters:**
4 LOT HOURIA, Boulevard Palestine
Mohammedia – Morocco

**Phone:** +212 6 63 71 40 40
**Email:** contact@oranostrans.com

### 2. Purpose

The purpose of these General Terms and Conditions is to define:

*   The terms of access and use of the site
*   The conditions for quote requests
*   The rules applicable to transport and logistics services
*   The rights and obligations of the parties

### 3. Site Access

The site is accessible free of charge to any user with internet access. ORANOS TRANS reserves the right to suspend, interrupt, or limit access to the site at any time, notably for maintenance reasons, without this giving rise to any compensation.

### 4. Quote Request

The site allows users to submit quote requests by providing information regarding their transport needs (nature of cargo, weight, dimensions, origin, destination, attached documents, etc.).

Any quote request does not constitute a contractual commitment. The contract is only deemed formed after written validation of the quote by ORANOS TRANS and acceptance by the client.

### 5. Transport and Logistics Services

The services offered by ORANOS TRANS notably include:

*   National and international road transport
*   Associated logistics services
*   Organization and tracking of transport operations

Services are executed in accordance with the information provided by the client. Any erroneous or incomplete information incurs the exclusive responsibility of the client.

### 6. Client Obligations

The client agrees to:

*   Provide accurate, complete, and true information
*   Comply with regulations applicable to the transport of goods
*   Guarantee the conformity of the transported goods
*   Settle payments according to the agreed conditions

The client remains responsible for the content, packaging, and legality of the goods entrusted for transport.

### 7. Rates and Payment Terms

Service rates are communicated in the quotes established by ORANOS TRANS. Unless otherwise stated, prices are expressed excluding taxes. Payment terms (deadlines, means of payment, late penalties) are specified in the quote or the contract concluded with the client.

### 8. Responsibility

ORANOS TRANS implements all necessary means to ensure the proper execution of services. However, the company's responsibility cannot be engaged in case of:

*   Force majeure
*   Client fault or negligence
*   Inaccurate information provided by the client
*   Indirect or immaterial damages

ORANOS TRANS's responsibility is limited in accordance with current transport regulations.

### 9. Insurance

Transported goods may be covered by insurance according to the conditions provided in the contract or accepted quote. It is up to the client to subscribe, if necessary, to any additional required insurance.

### 10. Intellectual Property

All elements present on the site (text, images, logos, graphics, structure, etc.) are protected by current intellectual property laws. Any reproduction or use without prior authorization is strictly prohibited.

### 11. Personal Data

Personal data collected via the site is processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy and Moroccan Law No. 09-08 relating to the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data.

### 12. Modification of General Terms and Conditions

ORANOS TRANS reserves the right to modify these General Terms and Conditions at any time. New conditions take effect as soon as they are published on the site.

### 13. Applicable Law and Competent Jurisdiction

These General Terms and Conditions are governed by Moroccan law. Any dispute relating to their interpretation or execution falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of Moroccan courts.
